resources.name: Missouri Lawyers' Assistance Program (MOLAP)

phones.label: MOLAP toll-free
phones.hoursNote: Staffed business hours by a licensed clinician; Director accessible after hours by cell via the toll-free line

resources.confidential: Always confidential; not reported to Disciplinary Counsel, Board of Law Examiners, or Bar staff
resources.description: Free, confidential counseling and referral program of The Missouri Bar for lawyers, judges, law students, and families (substance use, depression, stress, burnout). Staffed by a licensed clinician; funded by the Bar with support from The Bar Plan Insurance Company.

resources.name: Montana Lawyer Assistance Program (LAP)
resources.confidential: Confidential by Montana Supreme Court Order No. 85-96; independent of any disciplinary organization
resources.description: State Bar of Montana program: confidential guidance, referral, intervention, and family support for impaired legal professionals, plus weekly online support groups (Addiction Recovery Tue noon; Mental Health Wed noon).

resources.name: Nebraska Lawyers Assistance Program (NLAP)
resources.operator: Nebraska Supreme Court (Judicial Branch); co-presented with the Nebraska State Bar Association
resources.confidential: Attorney-client-equivalent under Neb. Rule of Prof. Conduct §3-501.6(c)
resources.cost: Free (funded by Supreme Court through mandatory dues; NSBA voluntary dues not required)
resources.description: Statewide program (Nebraska Supreme Court) for lawyers, judges, and law students: assessment and referral, formal interventions, a geographically matched peer-support network, and education for substance abuse, stress, depression, and cognitive decline.

resources.name: Nevada Lawyer Assistance Program (NLAP)

phones.label: Confidential hotline (answered by a fellow lawyer)
phones.hoursNote: Secondary source claims 24/7; not confirmed on a loaded page (nvbar.org 403'd)

resources.confidential: Confidential; voluntary self-report or Bar Counsel referral
resources.cost: Free initial evaluation; first five therapy sessions free (expanded from three), statewide + secure video
resources.description: State Bar of Nevada clinical program for attorneys/judges: assessment, treatment referral, ongoing monitoring, and a member therapy benefit (five free vetted-therapist sessions, statewide/online). nvbar.org 403'd this session, so corroborated.

resources.name: Lawyers Concerned for Lawyers (LCL) — Nevada

phones.label: Confidential peer hotline
phones.hoursNote: Leave only first name and phone number; nvbar.org 403'd

resources.confidential: Completely confidential; does not police or discipline
resources.cost: Peer support and AA meetings free; first five therapy sessions free
resources.description: Peer-support program (est. mid-1980s) of attorneys in recovery: one-on-one peer help, statewide closed-door AA meetings, and therapist referrals. nvbar.org 403'd this session, so corroborated.

resources.name: New Hampshire Lawyers Assistance Program (NHLAP / LAPNH)
resources.operator: New Hampshire Lawyers Assistance Program (NH Supreme Court Rule 58)
resources.confidential: Complete confidentiality; NHLAP members relieved of the duty to report ethical violations
resources.cost: Free (funded through bar member renewal fees)
resources.description: Independent program under NH Supreme Court Rule 58 (2007): in-person and virtual help, referrals, peer-recovery meetings, and education for mental health, substance use, and work-life balance. Serves lawyers, judges, law students/applicants, and families. Real domain is lapnh.org.

resources.name: New Jersey Lawyers Assistance Program (NJLAP)
resources.operator: New Jersey Lawyers Assistance Program (NJ Court Rule 1:28B)

phones.label: NJLAP helpline
phones.hoursNote: njlap.org 403'd; verified via the NJ Judiciary official page

resources.cost: Free (funded by a mandatory annual assessment on every licensed NJ attorney)
resources.description: Statewide program (NJ Court Rule 1:28B) for NJ lawyers, judges, law students, and graduates: substance-use recovery, mental-health support, and well-being programming, including senior-attorney and small/solo-firm support. Anchored to the NJ Judiciary page since njlap.org 403'd.

resources.name: New Mexico Lawyer Assistance Program (NM LAP)
resources.confidential: Communications to the program are statutorily privileged
resources.description: Free, confidential State Bar program for judges, attorneys, law students, and legal staff: a confidential helpline, substance-use assessments, peer support, and referrals. Formerly the Judges and Lawyers Assistance Program.

resources.name: The Solutions Group — NM LAP Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
resources.operator: The Solutions Group (contracted by the State Bar of New Mexico)
resources.cost: Free (up to four counseling sessions per issue per year; session count corroborated from search)
resources.description: The State Bar's outsourced EAP, delivered by The Solutions Group (solutionsbiz.com): free confidential counseling for any mental/behavioral-health issue for members and families, part of NM LAP.

resources.name: In This Together Fund
resources.operator: State Bar of New Mexico / NM Bar Foundation (via NM LAP)
resources.confidential: Associated with the confidential NM LAP
resources.description: NM LAP donation-supported fund (Bar Foundation) helping cover treatment/assistance costs for members in need. Detailed eligibility text not extractable this session.

resources.name: North Carolina Lawyer Assistance Program (NC LAP)
resources.confidential: All communications with LAP staff are strictly confidential
resources.description: Free, confidential, non-disciplinary program of the NC State Bar for lawyers, judges/magistrates, law students, and families: intake, short-term counseling, referrals, case management, monitoring, support groups, and a peer-counselor volunteer network (formerly PALS/FRIENDS). After-hours crises → 988.

resources.name: BarCARES of North Carolina
resources.operator: North Carolina Bar Association (clinically administered by HRC Behavioral Health & Psychiatry, P.A.)
resources.cost: Cost-free to members of participating bar groups and law schools
resources.description: Confidential short-term counseling/assessment/referral program of the NC Bar Association, delivered by HRC Behavioral Health (typically a three-session assessment/referral benefit). BarCARES and NC LAP cross-refer.

resources.name: North Dakota Lawyer Assistance Program (LAP)
resources.operator: State Bar Association of North Dakota (ND Supreme Court Administrative Rule 49)

phones.label: SBAND main line (route to LAP)
phones.hoursNote: Brochure carries no phone; SBAND main number corroborated from search

resources.confidential: Confidential under N.D. Sup. Ct. Admin. R. 49 §4; not disclosed without consent
resources.description: SBAND's confidential program (est. 2004 under Admin. Rule 49) for North Dakota attorneys, judges, UND law students, and families: referral and ongoing support for alcohol/drug abuse, stress, depression, and practice-management problems. Verified via the official SBAND LAP brochure PDF.

resources.name: The Village Business Institute — Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
resources.operator: The Village Family Service Center / The Village Business Institute
resources.confidential: Professional and confidential assessment, counseling, and referral
resources.description: Fargo-based EAP vendor reported as the outsourced clinical resource associated with ND lawyer wellbeing. The ND-LAP-to-Village linkage is search-corroborated, not confirmed on a loaded official page (sband.org LAP page 403'd).

resources.name: Ohio Lawyers Assistance Program (OLAP)

phones.label: Main helpline (statewide toll-free)
phones.hoursNote: A secondary snippet claimed 24/7; not confirmed on a loaded page

resources.confidential: 100% confidential (FAQ); 'No one will ever know you called'
resources.cost: No fee unless you have a recovery contract; assistance never denied for money reasons
resources.description: Private nonprofit 501(c)(3) (since 1991) for Ohio judges, attorneys, and law students: confidential assessment, treatment referral, formal interventions, monitoring/recovery contracts, and family/colleague support (substance use, depression, anxiety, bipolar, PTSD, gambling).

resources.name: Toledo Bar Association Member Assistance Program (MAP)
resources.operator: Toledo Bar Association (clinical services via Lighthouse Telehealth LLC)
resources.cost: TBA pays up to six one-hour appointments/year; member pays beyond six
resources.description: Metro member benefit for Toledo Bar Association members: confidential professional counseling via Lighthouse Telehealth for stress, marital problems, substance abuse, and job burnout. Official page 403'd this session, so corroborated.

resources.name: Lawyers Helping Lawyers Assistance Program (LHL)
resources.operator: Oklahoma Bar Association (hotline answered by a contracted counseling service)

phones.label: LHL confidential hotline (after-hours reaches licensed pros)
phones.hoursNote: Answered by a counseling service incl. after-hours; no literal 24/7 statement

resources.confidential: By statute and OBA resolution, any information received must remain completely confidential
resources.cost: Up to six hours of free short-term/crisis counseling for all OBA members; grants via the LHL Foundation
resources.description: OBA's LAP for members facing substance abuse, depression, stress, anxiety, relationship challenges, or gambling: off-site coordinator/contracted counseling, peer mentoring, and monthly discussion groups (OKC and Tulsa).

resources.name: Lawyers Helping Lawyers Foundation
resources.operator: Lawyers Helping Lawyers Foundation (affiliated with the OBA LHL program)
resources.confidential: Part of the confidential LHL program
resources.cost: Grants to help pay for treatment or medication
resources.description: Nonprofit funding trust affiliated with the OBA's LHL program that awards grants for treatment or medication beyond the six free counseling hours.

resources.name: Oregon Attorney Assistance Program (OAAP)
resources.operator: Oregon State Bar Professional Liability Fund (PLF)

phones.label: Local (Portland); urgent after-hours
phones.hoursNote: Office 8:30a-5:00p M-F; same number for urgent after-hours matters, no 24/7 designation

resources.confidential: Completely confidential; will not affect standing with the PLF or Oregon State Bar
resources.cost: Free (funded by the Professional Liability Fund)
resources.description: Statewide LAP for Oregon lawyers, judges, and law students (since 1982), staffed by attorney counselors: free confidential short-term counseling (in-office, phone, or teleconference), peer-support groups, workshops, and CLEs.
